server.name: io.github.brianfofficial/retentioncheck-mcp-server
server.description: Pull churn from Stripe or pasted feedback. AI-ranked drivers with severity + actionable fixes.
server.title: RetentionCheck

environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for running churn analysis (required for analyze_churn and analyze_stripe_churn; get_example_analysis works without it).
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Stripe API key for analyze_stripe_churn. Use a RESTRICTED (read-only) key with these permissions: Subscriptions Read, Customers Read, Prices Read. Create one at https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys/create. Optional — only required for the analyze_stripe_churn tool.
environmentVariables.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to opt out of anonymous usage telemetry. Telemetry tracks tool invocations and aggregate counts — never the feedback text, financial values, or any PII.
environmentVariables.name: RETENTIONCHECK_TELEMETRY

server.name: io.github.brianfofficial/retentioncheck-mcp-server
server.description: Pull churn from Stripe, Postgres, MySQL, or pasted feedback. AI-ranked drivers + fixes.
server.title: RetentionCheck

environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for running churn analysis (required for analyze_churn, analyze_stripe_churn, and analyze_sql_churn; get_example_analysis works without it).
environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Stripe API key for analyze_stripe_churn. Use a RESTRICTED (read-only) key with these permissions: Subscriptions Read, Customers Read, Prices Read. Create one at https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys/create. Optional — only required for the analyze_stripe_churn tool.
environmentVariables.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string for analyze_sql_churn when dialect='postgres'. Format: postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db?sslmode=require. Use a READ-ONLY user — see retentioncheck.com/integrations for the exact GRANT SQL. Optional — only required for the analyze_sql_churn tool with postgres dialect.
environmentVariables.name: POSTGRES_URL

environmentVariables.description: MySQL connection string for analyze_sql_churn when dialect='mysql'. Format: mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db?ssl=true. Use a READ-ONLY user — see retentioncheck.com/integrations for the exact GRANT SQL. Optional — only required for the analyze_sql_churn tool with mysql dialect.
environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to opt out of anonymous usage telemetry. Telemetry tracks tool invocations and aggregate counts — never the feedback text, financial values, or any PII.
environmentVariables.name: RETENTIONCHECK_TELEMETRY

server.name: io.github.briangaoo/whoop-mcp
server.description: Full read + write access to your Whoop fitness data via the private iOS API. 47 tools.

environmentVariables.description: Whoop Cognito access token. Obtain via `npm run cognito-bootstrap` from the repo, which prompts for your Whoop email + password + SMS MFA code, then writes both tokens to a local .env. Auto-refreshes every ~24h.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_IOS_BEARER_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Whoop Cognito refresh token (~30 day lifetime). Obtained alongside the bearer token from `npm run cognito-bootstrap`. When this expires, run `npm run rebootstrap` to get a fresh pair.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_COGNITO_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Your Whoop account email. Used only by the bootstrap script — the running server reads tokens, not credentials.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Your numeric Whoop user ID. Optional — used by whoop_profile and whoop_leaderboard. Avoids one redundant bootstrap call per session if set.
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_USER_ID

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone (e.g., America/Los_Angeles) for response timestamps. Optional — if unset, the server auto-detects from your Whoop profile's timezone_offset field (refreshed hourly).
environmentVariables.name: WHOOP_TIMEZONE
